description: This Java class defines a REST controller for authentication endpoints, handling user registration and login processes in a Spring Boot application. It interacts with an authentication service to process requests and returns mock tokens and user information.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: REST controller managing authentication operations such as registration and login.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, returns a mock token and user info.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, returns a mock token and username.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Endpoint for new user registration that returns a mock token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Endpoint for user authentication that returns a mock token.
